description: A squall's tower: a dark flat base, rows of towering puffs, an anvil spreading downwind at the top and a shelf cloud low over its gust front, ahead. Places and radii are shares of the system's size, along its track and across it; heights shares of its height above its base as it stands now. A layer grows as the cloud strength goes from grow's first to its second, so the base comes first and the anvil last; tone runs from the dark base (0) to the white top (1).
